title: Thermal Order in the Biconical Model
summary: Thermal fluctuations are generally expected to destroy order and restore symmetries at sufficiently high temperatures. Recently, however, a family of scalar theories in $2+1$ dimensions was shown to exhibit $\mathbb Z_2$ symmetry breaking that persists to arbitrarily high temperatures using a variety of approaches, including the $ε$-expansion, the FRG, and large-$N$ techniques. Although the similarities among these theories suggest that they belong to the same universality class, this connection has not been established explicitly. In this work, we fill this gap.
